content: Good afternoon. Reservations. May I help you?
Yes, I'm calling from Tenga Company. I'd like to know if you have rooms available for the nights from October 8 to October 12. We are going to have a business conference.
May I ask how many people there will be in the party?
What kind of room would you like?
A moment please, sir. Yes, I can confirm 10 rooms for those days.
Thank you. Is there a special rate for a group reservation?
Yes, there is a 10 percent discount.
